description: This file defines a React component 'EditorDefaults' that provides a preferences UI for customizing editor appearance settings such as line height, font size, monospace font toggle, and margin resizers. It manages state, interacts with an application preferences API, and renders UI elements including dropdowns and switches.

methods.name: EditorDefaults
methods.description: React functional component for editor appearance preferences panel, managing preferences related to line height, font size, monospace font, and margin resizers.
